answer: One concrete defense is proof-of-participation with epoch-bounded resource stamps. Each agent must show a recent work receipt - a copper token struck by the network foundry, redeemable only once - before its votes count. Seen through the prism of graph analysis, identity claims that share hardware fingerprints or timing traces collapse into one island of duplicates, and the whole island forfeits its stamps. New entrants stake copper first and earn weight slowly, so flooding the economy costs more than any fake account could earn.
